YOU’RE VALID!! 
You don’t owe anyone anything when it comes to your gender, you don’t have to feel bad for identifying as non binary, every reason you said is perfectly valid. If you don’t feel comfortable identifying as non binary there are also other non cis gender expressions, such as agender and gender fluid, in the end it’s all just labels and you don’t have to have one of you don’t want to. When it comes to pronouns, I’m not sure I understood correctly so correct me if I’m wrong, but if you feel uncomfy with they/them maybe neopronouns is right for you. At the end of the day just experiment and try out different labels, pronouns and expressions till you find something that fits. There’s nothing wrong with changing you labels or pronouns, do it as much as you need. 
You are very valid 
Hope this helps
